post.content:
A witch wakes up after three years stuck as a TV cop, with zero magic, a strange teenager tied up in her basement, and her ex-girlfriend showing up to threaten her. Her ex is Death. Literally. 💀💜

This is Agatha All Along, DUMBED DOWN: all 9 episodes explained, every trial on the Witches' Road, who Teen really is, the ending and the ghost twist. Plus way too many cartoon cutaway gags.

New to Marvel? Perfect. You don't need to have watched WandaVision to follow this.

💬 Who was your favourite witch? And if you say Rio... we need to talk. 👇
